title: Mont-Saint-Michel - The Tidal Abbey
lore: A granite island crowned by a Gothic abbey rises out of the tidal flats of Normandy. Ramparts wrap a medieval village that spirals up to the church, and the spire's golden archangel can be seen from every corner of the bay.
notes: Interior: abbey nave with columns and candles (CAM_Interior_Nave)
Rampart gap faces the causeway; 110 procedural village houses spiral the rock
